question: Let x be the greatest number by which when 448, 678 and 908 are divided, the remainder in each case is 11. When 147 is divided by x, the remainder is:
solution:
**Given:**

The given number = 448, 678 and 908

**Concept used:**

**HCF - **The highest number among all the common factors of the given numbers

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Subtract the remainder in the given number

⇒ (448 – 11) = 437

⇒ (678 – 11) = 667

⇒ (908 – 11) = 897

Now,

The HCF of 437, 667 and 897 

⇒ 437 = 19 × 23

⇒ 667 = 29 × 23

⇒ 897 = 39 × 23

So, The HCF is 23

⇒ x = 23

Now,

When 147 is divided by x

⇒ 147/23

The remainder = 9

**∴ The required remainder is 9**

⇒ (448 – 11) = 437

⇒ (678 – 11) = 667

⇒ (908 – 11) = 897

Now,

The HCF of 437, 667 and 897 

Use the difference method to find the HCF,

667 - 437 = 230 = 23 × 10

897 - 667 = 230 = 23 × 10

897 - 437 = 460 = 23 × 2 × 10

The biggest common factor is 23. The HCF is 23.

⇒ 147/23

The remainder = 9

∴ The required remainder is 9
